data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh device state from the cloud (15–600s, recommended 30–60s). The integration already speeds up briefly right after you control a device (adaptive), so a low value is rarely needed. Setting it too low may trigger server-side rate limiting and get your account or the whole service blocked.
